text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The NHK Mile Cup draws to a close.<n>Taiki Shuttle is
overjoyed, having<n>brought happiness to so many
people.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is where all the ace<n>Umamusume
gather—the Mile<n>Championship!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We enter the Unicorn Stakes in the<n>meantime—the
perfect race to gain<n>some much-needed experience.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Preparing for the big stage ahead,<n>Taiki Shuttle
tackles the dirt track<n>head-on.
